newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Vilnius Bank, other leading Lithuanian stocks gain.
newsitem.headline: Vilnius Bank, other leading Lithuanian stocks gain.

text.p: Market leader Vilnius Bank rose to a new high on the Lithuanian stock exchange on Thursday and traders said their in-house indices also gained again.
Vilnius rose to 1,200 litas from 1,100 litas and the Suprema securities firm said its index rose to 1,136 from 1,065.
"Many of the blue-chip stocks are undervalued, especially if you look at key financial ratios, and now they are approaching their true market price," a dealer at brokerage Vilfima said.
Overall central market volume was more than one million litas, with the market in the spotlight as investors switch to shares from government T-bills.
There were 470,000 litas of block trades while the secondary T-bill market saw just 30,000 litas of business, dealers said.
